messages.text: 🙋 [E1] Engine deep-dive — the E1 page is live for your review (give it a minute to refresh): https://kabir-agarwal.github.io/e1-live-site/engine-e1.html  It has: the one-line job + account + open trades; the pattern score cards (cases, win rate, confidence-adjusted win rate, avg move after costs, stage); the validation funnel with plain-word captions (found → sealed exam → walk-forward → luck correction → certified → live paper); and the calls + Download-Excel. The 210-stock × every-metric GRID (section 2) and the stock drill-down/timeline are placeheld — say yes and I wire the grid.

🙋 [E1] Three new tabs are live on the main site (give the page a minute to refresh): Deliverables — https://kabir-agarwal.github.io/e1-live-site/#deliverables (Requested line, index-test sentences, calls table, Download Excel). Messages — https://kabir-agarwal.github.io/e1-live-site/#messages (every desk message, newest first, 30 days, search by stock). Recording — https://kabir-agarwal.github.io/e1-live-site/#recording (every data lane from disk: status today, rows today, last time, 30-day green/red strip; red = missed today).
